question: Why did I bonk at my last race?
note: Drafted against the exact prompt this request produces, pending a live re-record with `npm run record:demo`.

response.answer: Brandywine Valley Marathon (Apr 19, 2026) reads less like a sudden bonk than a slow bleed. Your pace went from 4:25/km on the first split to 6:09/km on the last, with the largest single drop at km 40, and it was 27°C with 71% humidity, which the data flags as heat stress. Fueling compounds it: 52g carbs/hr against a 60–90g/hr target for a 205-minute effort, 8g/hr below the minimum. Heat and light fueling both line up with the fade, but one race can't tell you how much each contributed.
